headline: As of 2026-09-18: 6,530 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 3 of 50 states, D+48.1 registration lean.
bullets: 6,530 early/mail ballots cast so far across 3 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+48.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: North Carolina (4,727), Pennsylvania (1,654), Florida (149).
